response.sql: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) as overall_avg_bandwidth FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL), station_stats AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) as avg_bandwidth FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation) SELECT ss.observstation, ss.avg_bandwidth, ss.avg_bandwidth - oa.overall_avg_bandwidth as margin FROM station_stats ss CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE ss.avg_bandwidth > oa.overall_avg_bandwidth ORDER BY margin DESC LIMIT 10
